# x-twitter-scraper_x_space (Data Source)

X Space details, host, and speakers



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `space` (Attributes) X Space (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--space))

<a id="nestedatt--space"></a>
### Nested Schema for `space`

Read-Only:

- `admins` (Attributes List) Hosts and co-hosts (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--space--admins))
- `content_type` (String) Audio or video kind, as X names it
- `conversation_controls` (Number) X's code for who may speak
- `created_at` (String) When the Space was made
- `creator` (Attributes) Public X profile. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--space--creator))
- `disallow_join` (Boolean) Whether X lets no more accounts join
- `ended_at` (String) When the Space ended
- `id` (String) Space ID
- `is_available_for_clipping` (Boolean) Whether listeners may clip the Space
- `is_available_for_replay` (Boolean) Whether X offers a recording
- `is_employee_only` (Boolean) Whether only X employees may join
- `is_locked` (Boolean) Whether the host locked the Space
- `listeners` (Attributes List) Accounts X lists as listeners (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--space--listeners))
- `max_admin_capacity` (Number) Most hosts and co-hosts the Space allows
- `media_key` (String) X's media key for the Space's audio
- `mentioned_user_ids` (List of String) IDs of the accounts the host tagged
- `no_incognito` (Boolean) Whether anonymous listening is off
- `participant_count` (Number) Accounts in the Space now, while it is live
- `scheduled_start` (String) When the Space was set to start
- `sharings` (Attributes List) Posts the hosts and speakers shared in the Space, in X's order. Present only when X lists them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--space--sharings))
- `speakers` (Attributes List) Accounts X lists as speakers (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--space--speakers))
- `started_at` (String) When the Space went live
- `state` (String) NotStarted (scheduled), Running (live), Ended, Canceled (scheduled, never started) or TimedOut (closed by X, not by its host)
- `title` (String) Space title
- `total_live_listeners` (Number) Accounts that listened live
- `total_replay_watched` (Number) Accounts that played the recording
- `tweet` (Dynamic) Search tweet with author. Zero metrics may mean X omitted counts.
- `tweet_id` (String) ID of the post that announces the Space
- `updated_at` (String) When X last changed the Space

<a id="nestedatt--space--admins"></a>
### Nested Schema for `space.admins`

Read-Only:

- `affiliates_highlighted_label` (Attributes) Organization affiliation label shown on an X profile. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--space--admins--affiliates_highlighted_label))
- `id` (String)
- `is_blue_verified` (Boolean) Whether the account has X Premium verification
- `is_muted_by_admin` (Boolean) Whether a host muted the account
- `is_muted_by_guest` (Boolean) Whether the account muted itself
- `is_verified` (Boolean) Whether X shows a verified badge in the Space
- `joined_at` (String) When the account joined the Space
- `name` (String) Name the account shows in the Space
- `periscope_user_id` (String) The account's ID in X's broadcast service
- `profile_picture` (String) Profile picture URL
- `profile_picture_original` (String) The participant's profile picture at full size
- `username` (String)
- `verified_type` (String) Business or Government badge type

<a id="nestedatt--space--creator"></a>
### Nested Schema for `space.creator`

Read-Only:

- `account_based_in` (Attributes) Null when X shows no label. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--space--creator--account_based_in))
- `account_based_in_accurate` (Boolean) False when X notes accountBasedIn may be inaccurate.
- `account_based_in_unavailable` (Boolean) True when X withheld accountBasedIn from this read. Retry later.
- `advertiser_account_service_levels` (List of String) X Ads services the account uses, such as `analytics`, `media_studio` or `smb`. Empty for an account without ads.
- `advertiser_account_type` (String) The account's X Ads type. `none` for an account without ads, or `promotable_user` for one that may run them.
- `affiliate_username` (String) Handle of the organization X shows the account is affiliated with, from its About page.
- `affiliates_highlighted_label` (Attributes) Organization affiliation label shown on an X profile. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--space--creator--affiliates_highlighted_label))
- `automated_by` (String)
- `birthdate` (Attributes) The parts of the birthday the account made public. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--space--creator--birthdate))
- `business_account_affiliates_count` (Number)
- `business_profile_state` (String) Whether X treats the profile as a business profile. `none` or `enabled`.
- `community_role` (String) Community role when returned by community member reads
- `connected_via` (String) How the account first connected to X.
- `connected_via_accurate` (Boolean) False when X notes that country may be inaccurate.
- `contact_info` (Attributes) Emails, phone numbers & links the account publishes on its own profile. Omitted when it publishes none. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--space--creator--contact_info))
- `cover_picture` (String)
- `created_at` (String) Account creation time.
- `creator_subscriptions_count` (Number)
- `default_profile` (Boolean) Whether the profile keeps X's default theme.
- `default_profile_image` (Boolean) Whether the profile keeps X's default avatar.
- `description` (String)
- `email` (String) First email the account publishes on its profile, lowercased. Omitted when it publishes none.
- `fast_followers_count` (Number) Followers X counts as fast followers.
- `favourites_count` (Number)
- `followers` (Number) Omitted when X sends no count, as for the account that first posted reused media.
- `following` (Number)
- `geo_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the profile may add a location to posts.
- `grok_translated_bio` (Map of String) Public profile bio translation returned by X
- `has_custom_timelines` (Boolean)
- `has_extended_profile` (Boolean) Whether the profile filled X's extended fields, such as a birth date. True or false.
- `has_graduated_access` (Boolean)
- `has_hidden_subscriptions_on_profile` (Boolean)
- `highlights_info` (Attributes) Profile highlight availability and count metadata. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--space--creator--highlights_info))
- `id` (String)
- `identity_verification` (Attributes) Identity verification X shows on the profile & its About page. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--space--creator--identity_verification))
- `is_automated` (Boolean)
- `is_blue_verified` (Boolean) Whether X shows a blue verification badge
- `is_profile_translatable` (Boolean)
- `is_translation_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the account turned on X's translation of its posts. True or false.
- `is_translator` (Boolean)
- `is_verified` (Boolean) Whether X marks the profile as verified
- `listed_count` (Number) Public lists that include the profile.
- `location` (String) Account owner's public profile location text
- `media_count` (Number)
- `name` (String)
- `normal_followers_count` (Number) Followers minus fast followers.
- `parody_commentary_fan_label` (String)
- `pinned_tweet_ids` (List of String)
- `possibly_sensitive` (Boolean)
- `professional` (Map of String) Professional metadata with category display settings
- `profile_banner_url` (String) Original X profile banner field when available
- `profile_bio` (Map of String) Structured profile bio with entity annotations
- `profile_description_language` (String)
- `profile_image_shape` (String)
- `profile_interstitial_type` (String)
- `profile_picture` (String) Profile picture at 48 px, as X sends it.
- `profile_picture_original` (String) The same profile picture at full size, as the account uploaded it. Download this one for the image.
- `profile_sort_enabled` (Boolean)
- `profile_translator_type` (String)
- `protected` (Boolean) Whether the profile protects its posts
- `redirects_to_username` (String) Handle x.com sends this profile's visitors to, such as the new handle of a renamed account whose old handle now holds a placeholder. Missing when x.com shows the profile itself.
- `retweeted_at` (String) UTC repost time with includeRetweetTimestamp. Null if the newest profile page has no match or lookup failed. Otherwise omitted.
- `statuses_count` (Number)
- `subscribers_count` (Number) Accounts subscribed to the profile's paid Subscriptions. 0 when it has none.
- `super_follow_eligible` (Boolean)
- `super_follows_user_profile_active` (Boolean) Whether X marks the subscription profile as active.
- `tip_jar` (Attributes) Public payment and creator-support handles shown on X. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--space--creator--tip_jar))
- `unavailable` (Boolean)
- `unavailable_reason` (String)
- `url` (String)
- `username` (String)
- `username_changes` (Attributes) How often the account changed its username. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--space--creator--username_changes))
- `verification_reason` (Attributes) X's text on why the profile is verified, with its links. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--space--creator--verification_reason))
- `verified` (Boolean)
- `verified_type` (String)
- `withheld_in_countries` (List of String)
- `withheld_scope` (String) Whether X withholds a post or user

Read-Only:
